BiblicalUsage: A cooking hearth is a boiling place, and Ezekiel uses the word once, in the vision of the temple: there were boiling places under the rows, where the ministers of the house would boil the sacrifice of the people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the kitchens of the temple are holy: God provides a place for every part of the service, and nothing in His house is beneath His care.
